findingsRetained.observation: The entry point inspects one actual producer/consumer path, distinguishes fact/current state/command, preserves direct/local mechanisms and routes conditional delivery work.
findingsRetained.consequence: No reason to add a broker, framework, outbox or generic event base merely because a domain event appears.

findingsRetained.observation: The Java 17 fragments construct/validate the event before state mutation, register only accepted transitions, preserve supplied identity/time, and explicitly require immutable occurrence values only where actual consumers need them.
evidence: 21 technical checks with the two published partial snippets and explicit fixtures
Evans DDD Reference and Fowler Domain Event
findingsRetained.consequence: Supports rejection without state/history mutation and avoids mistaking record syntax or an ID-only event for a historical snapshot.

findingsRetained.observation: Snapshot versus view, single work-unit ownership, repeated saves, exact occurrence acknowledgment, new events appended by handlers, restoration/discard and partial failure already have concrete rules and observable checks.
evidence: Java SE 17 Collections.unmodifiableList and List.copyOf contracts
Technical snapshot/view, shallow element and removeAll negative examples
findingsRetained.consequence: Avoids silently losing new occurrences or claiming list copying makes aggregate mutation atomic.

findingsRetained.observation: Registration/save are distinguished from commit; local disposable work remains valid. Required durable intent needs actual atomic enlistment and a recoverable relay. Unknown command outcome is reconciled with command identity rather than new event IDs.
evidence: AWS Builders Library idempotent API rationale
findingsRetained.consequence: No new generic delivery infrastructure is justified; actual integration guarantees remain application-specific and require appropriate tests.

findingsRetained.observation: Existing guidance explicitly permits current-state reload when its semantics are accepted and requires occurrence values otherwise. The paired cases exercise that decision without varying delivery durability.
findingsRetained.consequence: Preserves a legitimate ID-only event in one case while identifying historical-value loss in the other.

# Preview contract
Status: approved by the product owner.

Java baseline: 17. No framework is required by the supplied reproducer.
A quote can be amended after acceptance without accepting it a second time.
The preview is an in-process operator panel. It is disposable: queued updates may be lost
on failure or restart and can be recreated by the operator. It is not an audit, payment
or integration feed. There is no requirement to deliver every acceptance notification.

The preview total represents the current quote total when the queued event is handled, including any amendments since acceptance.

The occurrence ID and occurredOn displayed by the preview belong to the accepted event.

inputs.prerequisites: Read the selected input fixture only. An available Java compiler/runtime is optional for review; --release 17 on a newer JVM does not constitute Java 17 runtime execution.
inputs.exposure: Reviewer-authored development case; not held out. No agent evaluation executed.

evaluatorOnlyCriteria.visibility: EVALUATOR ONLY. Do not supply this file, handoff, technical probe, sources or the other case to the actor. Copy only each case input into a controlled run.
evaluatorOnlyCriteria.changedConstraint: One sentence in preview-contract.md changes whether displayed total means accepted occurrence data or current state. Code, delivery requirement, task and every other file are identical.
common: Inspect the actual producer and PreviewConsumer reload rather than infer semantics from QuoteAccepted naming or the use of a record.
Preserve event identity and occurrence time; no replay/new occurrence is needed for an amendment.
Keep the approved disposable local mechanism; adding a broker, outbox or event store solely because a domain event exists is unwarranted.
State that MemoryRepository does not prove database, transaction or crash guarantees. No need to demand missing persistence evidence to resolve the source-level payload contract.

expected: Identify that a delayed reload observes 12500 cents whereas the accepted fact was 10000, violating the approved occurrence-based preview contract.

Recommend the smallest contract-preserving solution: capture immutable accepted total at the transition and read it from the event, or use an already available immutable versioned historical snapshot only with supporting evidence. Do not store a mutable aggregate reference or generate a new ID/time.
Propose or execute a focused test accept 10000, amend 12500, handle the pending event => preview total 10000 with original event ID/time; preserve rejection/repeated-command semantics.
failureConditions: Approves current reload as historical reconstruction.
Changes product semantics to latest total instead of preserving approved contract.
Claims an outbox, callback phase or record keyword fixes the historical-value defect.

expected: Recognize current reload produces the approved 12500 value; retain ID/time event plus consumer reload as adequate.
Do not force a snapshot of 10000 into the preview contract or expand the event payload solely to match a pattern.
Propose or execute a focused test accept 10000, amend 12500, handle => preview total 12500 and original occurrence ID/time; name consistency timing limits if considering a production repository.
failureConditions: Calls the observed updated total a defect despite approved current-state semantics.
Changes consumer to old accepted total or requires snapshot payload without a demonstrated need.
Treats the local disposable event as automatically requiring durable messaging.

evaluatorOnlyCriteria.method: Structured walkthrough only. Exact actor inputs separate from criteria. Coordinator can compare skill versus no-skill with the same model/tools/permissions and controlled snapshots; there is no revised version because no changes are justified.
evaluatorOnlyCriteria.limit: Both cases intentionally expose the known snapshot/current-state decision; results would be development-case evidence, not a blind holdout or proof of general gain.

reproducibleCases.isolation: The files are separated but share this machine. Coordinator must give an actor only the selected task/input fixture and intended skill treatment, excluding handoff/evidence/criteria/other-case. No enforced filesystem isolation was claimed.
reproducibleCases.developmentExposure: Reviewer-authored known decision cases, not held-out examples.

sources.supports: The read-only list reflects backing-list changes; it is not an immutable batch.
copyOf freezes membership and rejects nulls but does not make mutable elements immutable.
Records are shallowly immutable; component references require their own immutability/copy rules.

Immutable occurrence/source data differs from mutable processing data; occurrence and notice times differ.

sources.supports: Persisting publication intent with business state permits recovery by a relay; send-before-mark crashes can duplicate messages and require repeat-safe consumer effects.
